title: BREAKFAST
logline: Small domestic comedy, played entirely in the body. The family at its most functional — and its most fragile.
grade: The warmest grade in the episode: amber key, honeyed highlights, gentle highlight roll-off. Nothing in this scene may look cool.

narration.hi: घर में सुबह की आवाज़ें हमेशा एक जैसी थीं — चाय की केतली, माँ की डाँट, और विवान की हँसी।
narration.en: The sounds of morning at home were always the same — the kettle, Maa's scolding, and Vivaan's laugh.

narration.hi: उस वक़्त मुझे नहीं पता था कि ये मामूली सी सुबह मेरी सबसे कीमती यादों में से एक बन जाएगी।
narration.en: Back then I didn't know that this ordinary morning would become one of my most precious memories.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.05 m — table-top height, slightly below eye-line, looking across the table
shots.move: Static. Hands do the acting in the foreground.
shots.action: Parathas, a steel bowl of curd, four glasses of milk, one hand stealing, one hand swatting, one hand pouring.
shots.env: Dining table with a steel thali set, a plastic mat, a newspaper folded beside Pita's plate.
shots.light: Window light from frame-left skimming the table surface; the steel reflects small warm hotspots.
shots.vfx: Steam off the parathas; no bloom on the steel.
shots.cont: Table dressing is a registered set piece (SET-03). Same plates, same mat, every shot.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.20 m, seated eye-level, Aarohi frame-right facing camera-left
shots.action: Aarohi points her spoon at Ishaan's head, mimes an explosion, and grins.
shots.expr: Delighted cruelty. Eyebrows high, chin down.
shots.env: Dining table, Ishaan's shoulder a soft dark mass in the foreground-right.
shots.light: Warm key on Aarohi; foreground shoulder in shadow.
shots.vo: Silence — the joke has to land visually.
shots.cont: Her braid stays over her RIGHT shoulder in all breakfast shots.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.20 m, 60 cm, dead-on eye level
shots.action: Chews, stops, pats his hair down twice, fails, gives his sister a flat look, then goes back to eating.
shots.expr: Deadpan. Eyes only: 'really?' The mouth never changes.
shots.light: Warm key from the left, soft shadow side; catchlights in both eyes.
shots.vo: Line 2 begins at 05:34 — it must start on the flat look.
shots.cont: Jacket NOT worn yet in this scene — he is in the white shirt only. Signature jacket appears in S04.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.15 m, across the table, Vivaan frame-left
shots.action: Vivaan reaches across for a paratha, knocks his milk glass, and Maa's hand appears from frame-right and catches it without her looking.
shots.env: Dining table, milk sloshing but not spilling.
shots.light: Warm; the milk is the second-brightest object in frame.
shots.vfx: Tiny milk ripple; do not over-simulate.
shots.vo: Silence. One clean comedic beat, then cut.
shots.cont: Vivaan uses his LEFT hand — established habit, repeat in S09.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.45 m, near the main door, looking back into the room
shots.action: Pita stands, checks his watch, is handed a steel tiffin by Maa without a word exchanged. He nods once. She straightens his collar.
shots.env: Main door area, the family behind them at the table.
shots.light: Cool daylight at the door behind Pita; warm room light on Maa — the two-temperature frame returns.
shots.vo: Line 2 continues and ends here — on the collar straightening, not on the words.
shots.cont: The tiffin is prop P-02; it appears again in S09 on the kitchen counter.

shots.cam: Table height, 25 cm, macro on the hands
shots.move: Static. Cut to black at 06:58 with a 10-frame fade.
shots.action: Maa's hand slides a second paratha onto Ishaan's plate. His hand closes over it. Her hand withdraws, then returns to briefly pat his knuckles.
shots.env: Plate detail: steel thali, ghee sheen, fingerprints on the rim.
shots.light: Warm; the hand textures are the point of the shot.
shots.vo: Silence over the whole shot. The episode's thesis, delivered without a word.
shots.cont: Maa's bangles must ring — but per the audio rule, no sound effect is mixed; the motion must SUGGEST the sound.
